_comment: Per-million-token prices, supplied by YOU. Copy to pricing.json and fill in.
Deliberately shipped as zeros rather than as real numbers: prices change,
a stale table reports wrong spend with total confidence, and a confidently
wrong money figure is worse than no figure. The importer stores TOKEN
COUNTS only; cost is computed at read time against this file.
Cache reads and cache writes are priced differently from fresh input on
most providers, which is why imported_sessions keeps them in separate
columns. Folding them together would flatter a heavily-cached session.
